description: This file defines a mock class 'SessionServerManagerMock' for the 'ISessionServerManager' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server service component. It includes mock method declarations for initializing, starting, configuring, setting state, setting log levels, and pinging a session server.

classes.name: SessionServerManagerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISessionServerManager interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mocks the initialization method with command-line arguments.

methods.name: startService
methods.description: Mocks the method to start the session service.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Mocks setting the configuration for the session server, including socket name, state, resources, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Mocks setting the session server's state.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Mocks setting various log levels for different components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Mocks the ping method to check server responsiveness.
